title: spec.morphogen (DRAFT, v0)
description: DRAFT. Morphogen's own fields on a Backstage catalog entity, under the one key `spec.morphogen`. Phase 1 of the kit publishes this schema; nothing reads these fields yet (phase 2 loads them). The cell fields are those a cell in morphogen.yaml accepts today (morphogen/project.py, CellDoc), so a cell moves unchanged. What Backstage already holds is not repeated: a cell's `in` is the entity's subcomponentOf or system, `provides` and `consumes` are providesApis and consumesApis, `owner` and `lifecycle` are the entity's own. Use the Option fields on a Component with spec.lifecycle: candidate, the Cell fields on the entity a cell judges, the ApiTests fields on an API entity and the SystemSettings fields on the System entity. The fields are flat under `spec.morphogen`: the schema is the four definitions together, so one entity may carry the fields of more than one (a candidate that is also judged, say), and a field none of them defines is refused.

Option.description: An option for a role: carried by a Component with `spec.lifecycle: candidate`.

fills.description: Entity ref(s) of the part or role this could fill, as `[kind:][namespace/]name`.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema of the option's adjustable settings (what a tuner may move, with its bounds).

licence.description: An SPDX identifier where there is one, else the licence's name.

path.description: Where the fetched markdown docs are, relative to the project root. Absent until fetched.

evaluation.description: How it was measured against the need.

method.description: The trial: cases, command, where its output is kept.

Cell.description: A cell's rules, on the entity it judges. The fields of CellDoc in morphogen/project.py, less those Backstage holds (in, provides, consumes, owner, lifecycle). Commands run in `dir`, relative to the project root.

description.description: The cell's objective in words; GEPA's reflection reads it.

change.description: What may change: a path or glob, or a setting `path#NAME` / `path:dotted.key`, optionally `in lo..hi` or `in [a, b]`. Nothing else may.

keep.description: Settings held fixed inside a file `change` opens.

better.description: `metric higher|lower`, comma-separated for constraints after the primary; or {metric: higher|lower|{higher|lower, min, max_regression, gain, aggregate, primary}}.

tests.description: Commands that must pass; a failure refuses.

score.description: Scores each run's output, from the base.

observe.description: `otel`, or a command or observer object collected outside the run.

guard.description: false turns the system guard off; {max_regression: 0.1} sets how much the enclosing system may get worse.

requires.description: Guarantees the runner must provide for the cell to be judged at all.

ApiTests.description: On an API entity: the tests of the interface it names, run from the project root (InterfaceDoc in morphogen/project.py).

external.description: consumes: the system offers it; provides: the system relies on it.

SystemSettings.description: On the System entity: the judge's settings (Config in morphogen/documents.py, today the top level of morphogen.yaml) and defaults cells inherit, which replace YAML anchors.

autonomy.description: lifecycle -> what a pass allows (default review).

defaults.description: Fields a cell in this system inherits where it does not set them.
